cohort: The study included recipients, live donors, and neonates from nine live donor uterus transplantation procedures performed in a Swedish clinical trial setting.
finding: The total cost per child, from a health care perspective, was calculated to be EUR124,894, which decreased to EUR107,120 if only surgically successful transplants were considered.
mod_finding: Delivery for all children born following uterus transplantation was by caesarean section.
